policy.pipeline: discover → retrieve original record → record license/access → preserve raw reference/hash → normalize and deduplicate → independently reconcile → source-check reader claim → close gate
policy.statusRule: CANDIDATE_SOURCE_VERIFIED is NOT ORIGINAL_RECORD_INGESTED or NATIONWIDE_COMPLETE; never reduce outstanding gap count until acceptance evidence exists
policy.costRule: Prefer no-cost original public official datasets. Paid Alexandria provider credits, PACER fees and paid data are not approved by this tracker.
policy.provenanceRule: Separate allegations, filings, verified dispositions, associations and proven causal relationships; do not expose private individuals' sensitive details.
